key_developments.event: First Hansetag (Hanseatic Diet) at Lübeck formalises the League.
Treaty of Stralsund: Denmark grants the League sweeping trade privileges.
Ivan III closes the Novgorod Kontor; Russian trade collapses.

_quarry.description: A confederation of north German merchant towns and their trading posts (Kontore) across the North Sea and Baltic — Lübeck, Hamburg, Bremen, Cologne, Danzig, Bergen, Novgorod, London. Formally constituted at the Diet of Lübeck in 1356, the League dominated Baltic trade through the 14th and 15th centuries and could wage war as a corporate body (war against Denmark 1361–1370, Treaty of Stralsund 1370 cemented its commercial supremacy).
